syntheses.title: Lack of Effective Solutions to Error Accumulation in Closed-Loop Imitation Learning
syntheses.body: While mid-level representations and closed-loop simulation testing are employed to facilitate training and deployment of autonomous driving models (claims 5fc32090-a96e-5352-b867-05795d95ae56, e4571968-f7ab-5ab9-9db6-21554bbefe13), there remains a significant limitation due to error accumulation and distribution shift during closed-loop operation (claim c9759883-dd81-58a9-ab2d-155a512245df). This limitation contributes to failures such as the model getting stuck or colliding with parked vehicles despite viable passing options (claim cf5a09ec-bfde-5049-ac07-ec7d2e843d78). Furthermore, pure imitation learning approaches have been found insufficient even with large datasets and mid-level input/output representations (claim 639f88c8-001d-587a-bae9-390fb3c89dcf). However, current methods do not adequately address these challenges, indicating a gap in effective strategies to mitigate error accumulation and distribution shift in closed-loop imitation learning for autonomous driving.
